name: Ritual record keeper
design: Tall slender mature female with streamlined bronze mask, small stepped brow plates and broad rounded lower mask panel, fine but thick cylindrical scalp tendrils bound into one long cascade. Asymmetric olive robe with cream geometric border over fully covered brown trousers and sage high collar, light silver shoulder scale pieces. Holds a short CLOSED ceremonial record cylinder upright near chest and a tiny lidded seal box beside hip. Leaf-shaped pendants, narrow green sash and three different flat record pouches.
